name: AriaOS Intelligent Firewall & Live Connection Monitor
description: Real-time TCP/UDP socket & listening port inspection (/proc/net/tcp, ss), intelligent port blocking/allowing (ufw/nftables), and emergency network lockdown.

tools.name: firewall_status
tools.description: Inspect firewall engine state (ufw/nftables), default policies, lockdown mode, and active port rules.

tools.name: active_connections
tools.description: List active TCP/UDP network connections and listening ports with owning processes via ss and /proc/net/tcp.

tools.name: manage_port_rule
tools.description: Block or allow incoming/outgoing traffic on a specific TCP/UDP port.

tools.name: network_lockdown
tools.description: Enable or disable Emergency Network Lockdown (isolating all external network traffic).
